title: Chapter 197 The Death Of Lao Liu
content:
Chapter 197 The Death Of Lao Liu

The black light gradually solidified, and when he looked closely, it turned out to be the Immortal Soul Sect ancestor who had already escaped through the air!

Seeing the Immortal Soul Sect ancestor, Yan Lingyun sneered.

"What if I play tricks on you?"

As early as when the Immortal Soul Sect ancestor just appeared, the two saw that it was just a clone refined by the Immortal Soul Sect ancestor.

The real body is still hidden in the Immortal Soul Sect.

What's funny is that when Yan Lingyun slaughtered the Immortal Soul Sect, the Immortal Soul Sect ancestor turned a blind eye.

I'm afraid that all the people in the Immortal Soul Sect didn't think before they died that the Immortal Soul Sect ancestor who they hoped to return to save the Immortal Soul Sect was hiding below them.

Watching the entire Immortal Soul Sect completely destroyed.

"You have already destroyed my Immortal Soul Sect, do you have to kill us all?"

Looking at Yan Lingyun, who was at the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm in front of him, the Immortal Soul Sect ancestor still chose to compromise.

He didn't want to die.

If kneeling down could beg for mercy, then his knees would have fallen to the ground now.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun didn't say much, and directly told him the answer with her actions.

Boom!

Yan Lingyun punched out again.

Suddenly, the fist light mixed with the breath of destruction rushed directly towards the Immortal Soul Sect Patriarch.

At this moment, the Immortal Soul Sect Patriarch was extremely weak, and facing this attack, he naturally had no power to resist.

"Ah!!!"

"You forced me to do this!!"

In an instant, a powerful soul wave vibrated out of the body of the Immortal Soul Sect Patriarch.

Then, a dazzling fairy light rushed into the sky.

Boom!

The fist light hit the soul light of the Immortal Soul Sect Patriarch.

For a moment, the sky and the earth changed color.

The entire void began to collapse continuously.

The ninth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm!

Unexpectedly, the Immortal Soul Sect Patriarch had reached such strength.

With such strength, let alone in the Wood Immortal Realm, even if he went to the Central Region where there were many geniuses and strong men, he would be one of the strongest.

Unfortunately, he met Yan Lingyun.

The powerful soul light only lasted for a moment before it shattered.

Bang!

Suddenly, a shadow retreated tens of thousands of feet away, and the void shattered again.

Seeing this scene, Yan Lingyun did not speak and rushed over again.

At this moment, Yan Lingyun suddenly froze in place.

I saw that the shadow that retreated violently was actually a clone.

The real body of the Immortal Soul Sect ancestor actually went towards Lu Daosheng at a terrifying speed. Looking at this speed, it was obvious that the Immortal Soul Sect ancestor began to fight desperately.

Lu Daosheng stood in place, looking at the Immortal Soul Sect ancestor rushing towards him, and suddenly felt a little "at a loss".

Tsk!

A long knife emitting a hint of cold air was placed across Lu Daosheng's neck, as if it would separate Lu Daosheng's body in the next second.

"Woman, let me go, otherwise, I will immediately separate your man's body and scatter his soul!"

Buzz——

Suddenly, the long knife emitted a strong soul fluctuation.

It turned out to be an extremely rare soul attack immortal weapon.

The ancestor of the Immortal Soul Sect had no other choice. He couldn't beat him or run away, so he could only take a gamble. He couldn't see through the man in front of him, but he had never seen him take action.

This woman was already so strong, so this man shouldn't be more terrifying.

Otherwise, his worldview would collapse.

And now, seeing that the man in front of him and the woman in the distance did not move, the ancestor of the Immortal Soul Sect breathed a sigh of relief.

It seems that the gamble was right.

And at this moment, Lu Daosheng spoke.

"Why do you think I'm easier to bully?"

Lu Daosheng couldn't figure it out.

Do I look like a weak person?

Is it because I am too kind in my daily life?

However, the Immortal Soul Sect Patriarch did not answer Lu Daosheng, but said in a light voice: "In my life, I despise those who live off me the most."

In the distance, Yan Lingyun did not speak.

But Lu Daosheng looked grim.

"I get angry when you say that."

Ding!

A crisp metal collision sounded.

The immortal sword chopped Lu Daosheng's neck without leaving a mark.

"You!"

At this moment, the Immortal Soul Sect leader realized that something was wrong.

However, the next moment, he could not move.

"Don't bully honest people in the next life."

Lu Daosheng snorted lightly and slapped the Immortal Soul Sect Patriarch on the top of his head.

Suddenly, the Immortal Soul Sect Patriarch's eyes lost their luster in an instant.

A breeze blew by.

The ancestor of the Immortal Soul Sect turned into dust and disappeared with the wind.

With this, the sixth generation of the old man died.

At this time, Yan Lingyun came over.

"Lingyun, why didn't you kill him just now?"

With the opponent's kind of stuff, even if Lu Daosheng stood still, the opponent couldn't hurt Lu Daosheng at all.

But Yan Lingyun chose to stop when the opponent rushed towards Lu Daosheng.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun glanced to the side, "I forgot you are so strong."

Seeing Yan Lingyun like this, Lu Daosheng smiled and couldn't help hugging Yan Lingyun and kissing her fiercely.

"You, you should restrain yourself, we are outside."

A blush appeared on Yan Lingyun's white face, and she glared at Lu Daosheng fiercely.

However, Lu Daosheng looked at Yan Lingyun and smiled foolishly.

Just as she was about to do something else, Yan Lingyun suddenly said: "By the way, where are Xiaoxue and the others?"

......

At this moment, the air seemed to have frozen.

"Damn, I forgot!"

I thought of Huangcheng and Wanfeng, so I sent Lu Xue and others out, but I encountered someone asking for trouble.

This made Lu Daosheng forget this.

Yan Lingyun rolled her eyes, while Lu Daosheng quickly reached out and reached forward.

Suddenly, a space tunnel emerged.

Several figures slowly walked out from the depths of the tunnel.

Lu Xue was the leader, and Huang Shou and others followed closely behind.

"Wow, is this the fairy world?"

As soon as he came out, Lu Xue showed a look of surprise, but after a moment, the surprise on Lu Xue's face suddenly disappeared.

Because, she found that this place seemed to be better than her father's world.

No, it's far inferior.

"Dad, mom, where is this? Have you just arrived at the fairy world?"

Lu Xue walked to Lu Daosheng and the others.

Huang Shou and others also came over.

"Master, Madam."

Lu Daosheng and the others nodded slightly.

"Well, yes, we just arrived."

Lu Daosheng said haha.

Yan Lingyun turned her face and remained silent.

Upon hearing this, Huang Shou and others were confused.

It looks deserted here, with ruins besides ruins.

According to the city lord's convention, shouldn't the city of the deserted city be supported by the immortal world?

At this time, Lu Daosheng coughed.

"Stop watching, there's nothing here."

"Next, I have something important to you with Lingyun. You can go to the deserted city of the Ling Realm first."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng reached out and stroked lightly.

A crack in the void appeared in front of everyone.

Before everyone could speak, Lu Daosheng waved his hand again.

Suddenly, a force wrapped around everyone and entered the void tunnel directly.

Because of insufficient strength, forcibly entering the Void Tunnel will inevitably be strangled to death by the void turbulence inside.

Lu Daosheng didn't want to see all his trained subordinates receive the lunch box.
